plugins.name: outbound-engine
plugins.description: 24 Claude Code skills that execute the outbound block of a GTM system for B2B service companies (agencies, outsourcing, consulting). A master skill routes the nine-step path and enforces the gate between steps: signal catalog, ATS job-posting sourcing, signal and data-point research over an existing base, prospect-list research with per-row costs, contact and email enrichment through a priced cascade, two-stage scoring (pre-contact and post-contact), sequence copy with interest-only CTAs, a personalization pipeline, deliverability, per-reply objection handling, forensic reply audits, A/B analysis and weekly reporting. Built and battle-tested by Victor Shulga (Fractional CRO).
